commands.command:
sed -n '1,260p' README.md && printf '
--- tests/test_readme.py ---
' && sed -n '1,300p' tests/test_readme.py && printf '
--- build.py ---
' && sed -n '1,360p' build.py

sed -n '520,900p' build.py && printf '
--- s1 feed tests ---
' && sed -n '320,445p' tests/test_s1.py && printf '
--- s3 patch-view tests ---
' && rg -n -C 10 "patch-view|patch_view|history|deleted|outline|prior|previous|insert-before|insert-after|Q_patch" tests/test_s3.py
sed -n '900,1180p' build.py && printf '\n--- full README numbered ---\n' && nl -ba README.md
sed -n '1180,1245p' build.py && rg -n -C 4 "titleless|post_label|feed_item|render_feed|patch" tests/test_readme.py tests/test_s1.py tests/test_s3.py
sed -n '340,455p' build.py && sed -n '1,120p' tests/test_s1.py && sed -n '1,115p' tests/test_s3.py
